kind.description: What it renders: intro, outro, card, interstitial, caption, layout, overlay, transition.

description.description: One or two sentences: what it looks like and when to use it.

entry.description: Implementation file relative to the component folder (default index.tsx).

slots.description: Values the component renders, by name (title, kicker, logo…).

params.description: JSON Schema (type: object) of the params, with a default for each optional param.

tokens.description: Theme tokens the component reads: colors.accent, colors.text, colors.muted, colors.paper, background, fonts.display, fonts.body, logo, wordmark, brand.name, brand.url, cursor.ripple_color, style_bias, captions.kicker, captions.line, brandmark, motion.zoom_ease, colors.<key>.

duration.description: Seconds on screen (intros, outros, cards, interstitials, overlays, transitions).

geometry.description: Layouts: geometry in the 1920×1080 design space.

geometry_vertical.description: Layouts with the vertical variant: geometry in the 1080×1920 design space.

geometry_square.description: Layouts with the square variant: geometry in the 1080×1080 design space.

anchor.description: Tap target at the end of the segment (1920×1080 design space), for tap-open transitions.

anchor_vertical.description: Tap target in the vertical variant (1080×1920).

anchor_square.description: Tap target in the square variant (1080×1080).

slots.description: Sample slot values (every required slot not filled from the theme).

params.description: Params of the preview (over the defaults).

at.description: Seconds at which preview stills are taken (the committed preview.png shows the last one).

screen.description: Sample screen shown in the preview (layouts, captions, overlays, transitions; default desktop).

target.description: What an overlay preview points at on the sample screen: a button (default) or a text field (its region is the overlay's `screen`, as for a typing loupe).

preview.description: Sample values used to render previews with any theme.

type.description: text, image (a URL, or an image file of the project), url (shown as text), color (CSS), screen (the capture, layouts only), or data the scenario names: email (a wait_for_email `as`), document (a download `as` or a project file), notification (a captured web notification: its name or 1-based index), capture (a capture_text `as`), frame (a frame of the capture — a mark, start:/end:<scene>, 12.5s — or an image file), data (a CSV / TSV file of the project) — the component receives it as `props.media[<slot>]`.

description.description: What the slot shows (for the UI and Claude).

required.description: The component cannot render without it (default false).

default_from.description: Where the value comes from when the scenario does not set it: theme.logo, theme.wordmark, theme.brand.name, theme.brand.url, theme.outro.tagline, theme.outro.url, scenario.title.text, scenario.title.kicker, scenario.outro.tagline, scenario.outro.url, scene.caption.text, scene.caption.kicker, interstitial.text, interstitial.kicker.

max_chars.description: Soft length limit (text and url slots), used by validation and review.

SlotSpec.description: A value the component renders (title, kicker, logo, url…).

anyOf.description: Expression over the numeric params, the geometry vars and `aspect` (capture width / height): + - * / %, parentheses, min(), max(), round(), floor(), ceil(), abs() — e.g. "round((1920 - width) / 2)".

GeometryValue.description: Design px, or an expression over the params (e.g. "(1920 - width) / 2").

Rect.description: Rectangle in the design space (1920×1080 landscape, 1080×1920 vertical).

vars.description: Named values computed in order (each may use the params, `aspect` and the vars above it).

screen.description: Where the capture pixels go (the planner keeps the capture aspect ratio inside it).

frame.description: Outer shape around the screen (card, device…); defaults to screen.

chrome.description: Browser chrome bar, when the layout draws one.

caption.description: Caption area used by the caption component.

radius.description: Corner radius of the screen/frame, in design px (≥ 0).

LayoutGeometry.description: Layout geometry, so the planner and the review can reason without rendering. Values may be expressions over the params: the planner evaluates them for each use (e.g. a theme width moves the card and the caption rect).

Anchor.description: Where the component draws its tap target (a notification banner, an app icon) at the end of its segment: a transition such as studio/transition-tap-open zooms from it. Expressions may use numeric params, `<param>_<value>` one-hot names of string params (e.g. style_macos), vars and aspect.

ParamSchema.description: A JSON Schema (supported subset) of a param or of a nested value.

additionalProperties.description: Objects are closed unless this is set.

default.description: Value used when the param is not given (must match this schema).
